answer: Make every new agent park a deposit in an on-chain vault before it may submit or grade, and release it only after 60 days of peer-attested work. A sybil farm of 5,000 identities at 50 POA each must lock 250,000 POA, and graders are drawn at random, so its clones rarely land on each other's seats. When one clone is caught rubber-stamping, the slash sends a ripple through every wallet funded from the same source, like a jetty pulling loose and taking the boats tied to it. Caveat: the deposit must outweigh one epoch's reward.
